source.description: Where this entry's effective value came from: `template` (inherited from the category template), `add` (exclusive to this product), `override` (this product's own price for an inherited service). Drives the admin badges; inert for the storefront.

compareAtPrice.description: Original price for discount display (from product)

maxQty.description: Maximum orderable quantity for this line — available stock capped at the per-item limit; 0 means out of stock. The raw stock figure is intentionally not exposed (TASK-205).

isActive.description: Whether this line is still buyable — the product position is active AND its category is (TASK-297). `false` means the item has been withdrawn from sale and the storefront must mark the line unavailable; it is the SAME flag a deactivated product has always raised, so no second "unavailable" mechanism exists.

availableAddons.description: Add-on services offered for this line, already resolved through the category template + product deltas (TASK-174). Empty when the product has none.

selectedAddonIds.description: Ids of the add-ons the customer has selected on this line. Always a subset of `availableAddons` — a stale selection (the service was deactivated or removed from the product) is filtered out of every read.

subtotal.description: Sum of (price × quantity) for all items as string

itemCount.description: Total number of items (sum of quantities)

addonsTotal.description: Sum of the SELECTED add-on services across all lines, as string (TASK-174). Flat — an add-on is charged once per line, never multiplied by the line quantity. Reported separately from `subtotal`, and never part of the discount base (a coupon reduces the product subtotal only).

id.description: Payment attempt id. This is the identifier sent to the provider as ITS order id

amount.description: Amount charged, as a decimal string

status.description: Lifecycle of this attempt

providerPaymentId.description: The provider's own id for the transaction

settledAt.description: When the attempt reached a final state

amount.description: Amount to refund as a decimal string. Omit to refund in full.

verifiedPurchase.description: Whether the author has purchased this product (badge signal)

isActive.description: Whether the review is approved and visible on the storefront

ratingAverage.description: Average approved-review rating (1–5), or null when there are no reviews

data.description: Approved reviews for the current page

comment.example: Excellent case, fits perfectly and feels premium.

verifiedPurchase.description: Whether the author has purchased this product (badge signal)

isActive.description: Whether the review is approved and visible on the storefront

ids.description: Ids of the reviews being moderated.

action.description: `approve` publishes the reviews to the storefront. `reject` DELETES them permanently.

totalRevenue.description: Lifetime earned revenue (paymentStatus = PAID orders only)

revenueLast30Days.description: Earned revenue in the last 30 days

unrealizedRevenue.description: Unrealized revenue: sum of Order.total where paymentStatus != PAID and status not in (CANCELLED, REFUNDED)

unrealizedRevenueLast30Days.description: Unrealized revenue in the last 30 days

averageOrderValueLast30Days.description: Average order value over the last 30 days: earned revenue ÷ count of PAID orders in the window, 0 when there are no paid orders

revenueByDay.description: Daily revenue for the last 30 days

status.description: Order status

count.description: Number of orders with this status

ordersByDay.description: Daily order count for the last 30 days

newUsersByDay.description: Daily new-user count for the last 30 days

repeatBuyerRate.description: All-time share (0..1) of customers with 2+ non-CANCELLED orders (repeat buyers)

repeatBuyerRateLast90Days.description: Repeat-buyer share (0..1) restricted to orders created in the last 90 days

totalRevenue.description: Total revenue earned by this product

lowStockProducts.description: Positions at or below the low-stock threshold

averageProcessingHoursLast30Days.description: Average hours from order creation to first SHIPPED transition, for orders created in the last 30 days that have shipped at least once; 0 when none have shipped

unpaidInTransit.description: Active orders not yet paid — paymentStatus != PAID AND status NOT IN (CANCELLED, REFUNDED)

failedMails.description: Outbound emails permanently failed (MailOutbox status = FAILED)

pendingOver48h.description: Orders sitting in PENDING for more than 48 hours (subset of newOrders)

source.description: Opt-in surface for attribution (e.g. home, promo, blog)

subscribed.description: Always true on a successful (idempotent) subscribe

unsubscribed.description: Always true on a successful (idempotent) unsubscribe

status.description: Subscription lifecycle state

source.description: Where the opt-in came from (e.g. home, promo, blog)

unsubscribedAt.description: When the subscriber last unsubscribed (null while SUBSCRIBED)
